## What counts as accurate

Each CCN must have a traceable standing finding, the date and source supporting that finding, separate latest retrieval observations, and either a completed proof review or a specific documented uncertainty. An inaccessible endpoint does not establish that a hospital has no file. A newer failed check must not erase stronger historical evidence. Historical success must not be presented as fresh verification.

## Work sequence

1. Preserve and fingerprint source inputs. Join the crawl, resolution ledger, discovery review, nationwide review, browser/search evidence and manual corrections by exact CCN. Identify duplicates, missing records and contradictory assignments.
2. Repair evidence precedence and presentation. Keep standing evidence distinct from latest observations. Ensure rows, file summaries, manual overrides, detail panels, history and aggregate counts use consistent rules. Regression-test both promotions and downgrades.
3. Audit retained proof before making more requests. Check cached pointer bytes, exact pointer-to-file linkage, file bytes/hash, facility name and street/state, declared date and version. Deduplicate shared requests, but decide facility identity separately for each CCN.
4. Investigate the discrepancy queue in priority order: identity quarantines; conflicting manual corrections; changed file links; unsupported metadata or identity summaries; then incomplete discovery. Use targeted web search and official pages for identity/renaming/campus questions, browser navigation for inaccessible or dynamic pages, and capped downloads for file headers. A retry needs a stated reason or a new route.
5. Apply only supported corrections with provenance and superseded history. Leave genuine uncertainties open with observed date, attempted methods, exact blocker and next action. Rebuild the tracker and regenerate the queue after accepted batches.
6. Audit all 5,419 final rows and the rendered tracker. Verify unique CCNs, source coverage, link/metadata alignment, date handling, history, totals, tests and public-data privacy. Report local validation separately from any future publication.
